in_sanskrit.name: Dilraj
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Heart Ruler
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Dilraj एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Dil means heart and Raj means ruler or king. This name is derived from Sanskrit and is often given to boys in Hindu tradition. It symbolizes a brave and compassionate leader with a strong connection to the emotions.
